reviews.reason: Initial seven-case profile against merged PR #57 observed-AI rules. Reviewed all five actual alternating pairs (35 measurements per revision): all seven deterministic counters and bytes match before/after and both revisions complete within the proposed ceilings. Compared with the earlier unmerged six-case proposal, main now emits decision/knowledge events and swordsman/sky-mage reaches its configured 6000-step draw (2460 events; 8763519 log bytes). The new seer/ember case completes its configured 250-step draw (221 events; 690710 log bytes). This preserves approved main behavior and all existing Golden/boundary expectations. Most positive operation ceilings retain roughly 20-50% headroom; tiny counts round up, zero counters stay strict, configured 6000/250-step boundaries remain exact, and trajectory ceilings allow roughly twice measured encoding bytes. These are regression ceilings, not product capacity or wall-time/RSS guarantees. Failed/missing baseline observations cannot be waived.
